title: The Latest Crier for Sep 16, 2026

Special Event: Storytelling, Curiosity & Connection with Harry Smith

Central College students are invited to a conversation with award-winning journalist and Central College alumnus Harry Smith, joined by marketing professionals from AMA Iowa. The conversation will explore how strong stories are built, why curiosity matters, and how meaningful communication helps people connect across journalism, marketing, and professional life. 

Tuesday, September 15 

11:00–11:45 a.m. 

Recital Hall, Cox-Snow Music Center 

The event is free and open to all Central College faculty and students. 

For more information, please contact Stavros Papakonstantinidis at papakonstantinidiss@central.edu
